summary.text: Jason DeWitt is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 25, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Natchitoches and Rapides parishes. First elected in 2023, Jason DeWitt chairs the Louisiana Rural Caucus and sits on the Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development and Appropriations committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Jason DeWitt's occupation as owner of Terminator Pest and Pond Management, LLC, with a B.S. from Northwestern State University.

The House page lists Jason DeWitt's committee assignments as Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Appropriations, Natural Resources and Environment, Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, and House Select Committee on Disaster Recovery, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Rural Caucus (chair), Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus, and Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
